context.label: Bounded context in PascalCase, already created by hex-context (e.g. Transfers)

use_case.label: Use case the route drives, in PascalCase: a row of the Driving adapters table in docs/<context>/domain-model.md, already generated by hex-use-case (e.g. TransferMoney)

description: New HTTP endpoint of a context, read from its row in the Driving adapters table of docs/<context>/domain-model.md (route, use case, answers) and the use case's command: src/Bank.Api/<Context>/<UseCase>Endpoint.cs with the request record (the command fields the route does not carry), the route parameters, the success status and the OpenAPI problem responses, its .Map<UseCase>() in the <Context>Endpoints group, and a request in <Context>.http. Use it for every new route instead of hand-writing one.
